app_positioning.description: Offline-first helper for CND1 display symbols, D15 LED flash errors, wiring/procedure issues, and recommended checks. No login, no recording, no backend required for v1.

tools.purpose_zh: 檢查顯示符號、接線、插頭、bridge、門體狀態、safety device 和 junction box。
tools.safety_note_zh: 確認門不會突然運行，避免站在門運行路徑內。
tools.purpose_en: Inspect display symbols, wiring, connectors, bridges, door condition, safety devices, and junction boxes.
tools.safety_note_en: Make sure the door cannot move unexpectedly and stay out of the door travel path.

tools.purpose_zh: 檢查 24 VDC / 12 VDC、terminal、connector、stop chain、encoder supply 等。
tools.safety_note_zh: 帶電測量只限合資格技術人員。
tools.purpose_en: Check 24V DC, 12V DC, terminals, connectors, stop circuit, and encoder supply.
tools.safety_note_en: Live measurements must be performed only by qualified personnel.

tools.purpose_zh: 確認 switch 1 programming mode、switch 4 factory reset 或其他設定位置。
tools.safety_note_zh: 更改 DIL switch 前確認流程與設備狀態。
tools.purpose_en: Check switch 1 programming mode, switch 4 factory reset, and other DIL switch positions.
tools.safety_note_en: Confirm the procedure and equipment status before changing any DIL switch.

tools.purpose_zh: 查看 display symbol、programming display、E-code、FAC、SER 等。
tools.safety_note_zh: 不要只根據單一顯示判斷，需依 manual 流程檢查。
tools.purpose_en: Read display symbols, programming display, E-codes, FAC, SER, and other status messages.
tools.safety_note_en: Do not rely on one display only. Follow the manual checks.

tools.purpose_zh: 用於 serious fault / SER 或 encoder position 無變化時，將門移離 end position 或移至中間位置。
tools.safety_note_zh: 手動移門前確認門平衡、安全、無人處於門下方或運行路徑。
tools.purpose_en: Move the door away from end positions or to a middle position when SER or encoder-position errors require it.
tools.safety_note_en: Before manual movement, confirm the door is balanced, safe, and no one is under or inside the travel path.

tools.purpose_zh: 用於 quick start 中調整 CEE plug phase reversal 或指定端子操作。
tools.safety_note_zh: 相序調整與電氣操作只限合資格人員。
tools.purpose_en: Used for CEE plug phase reversal or specified terminal operations in the quick-start procedure.
tools.safety_note_en: Phase reversal and electrical work must be performed only by qualified personnel.

display_symbols.meaning_en: Stop chain / stop circuit related error.
display_symbols.meaning_zh: 停止迴路、安全停止或 drive stop 相關錯誤。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 end positions 是否已正確設定；若未設定，先重新設定 door end positions。
檢查 green spiral cable connector；必要時在 yellow / black 所在位置放 temporary bridge 作隔離測試，找到問題後移除 bridge。
檢查 X3.1 1-2（red connector）與 X3.2 3-4 的 bridges/connectors 是否正確並接觸良好。
檢查 X3.9 28-29 與 X2 4-5 safety jumper plug。
檢查 drive emergency stop：KE chain、KU crank 或 E disconnection 狀態。
必要時在 X13 2-5 放 temporary bridge；若錯誤消失，問題方向在 drive 或 motor cable。
recommended_checks_en: Check whether end positions are correctly programmed.
Inspect the green spiral-cable connector and the yellow/black stop-circuit wires.
Check bridges/connectors at X3_1 1-2, X3_2 3-4, X3_9 28-29, X2 4-5, and X13 2-5.
Use the stop-circuit 24V sequence meter test to locate the first interrupted terminal.
If a temporary bridge is used for isolation testing, remove it after identifying the fault.

display_symbols.title_zh: 鬆纜開關 / 小門開關錯誤
display_symbols.meaning_en: Circuit for slack-cable switch and/or wicket-door switch is interrupted.
display_symbols.meaning_zh: 鬆纜開關和/或小門開關迴路中斷。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 spiral cable 的 green connector X20 是否位置正確。
確認 yellow cable 在上方 position 4，black cable 在下方 position 3。
檢查門板上的 junction boxes。
移除 slack-cable switch 與 wicket-door switch 的 cables，並用 supplied red jumper plugs 替換進行隔離測試。
若錯誤仍不消失，先更換 spiral cable，再檢查 / 更換 door seal 內的 6-pole connection cable。
逐一重新連接 slack-cable switch 與 wicket-door switch cable，直到找到故障點。
recommended_checks_en: Check the green connector X20 on the spiral cable.
Confirm the yellow cable is at position 4 and the black cable is at position 3.
Inspect door-leaf junction boxes, slack-cable switch, and wicket-door/pass-door switch.
Use supplied jumper plugs only for isolation testing, then restore the safety circuit.
If the error remains, inspect the spiral cable and door-seal connection cable.

display_symbols.meaning_zh: 門停在兩個終點位置之間，未發現錯誤。
recommended_checks_zh: 這是 info message，不一定是故障。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Nothing active / 4-chairs symbol.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

display_symbols.meaning_zh: 門已到達開門終點位置。
recommended_checks_zh: 這是 info message，不一定是故障。
若位置不正確，重新設定 open/closed end positions。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: End position OPEN reached.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

display_symbols.meaning_zh: 門已到達關門終點位置。
recommended_checks_zh: 這是 info message，不一定是故障。
若位置不正確，重新設定 open/closed end positions。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: End position CLOSED reached.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

recommended_checks_zh: 這是 info message，不一定是故障。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: End position 1/2 OPEN reached.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

display_symbols.meaning_zh: X3.2 5-6 外部開門按鈕啟動；loop detector 啟動也可能顯示此符號。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 external OPEN pushbutton 是否卡住。
檢查 loop detector 是否正在啟動。
檢查 X3.2 5-6 端子。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: External pushbutton OPEN active.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

display_symbols.meaning_zh: X3.2 7-8 外部關門按鈕啟動。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 external CLOSED pushbutton 是否卡住。
檢查 X3.2 7-8 端子。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: External pushbutton CLOSED active.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

display_symbols.meaning_zh: GA impulse function 啟動；若要用 GA function 關門，需要 safety contact edge + photo cell 或 X3.6 20-22 bridge。
recommended_checks_zh: 確認 X3.6 20-22 是否有 safety contact edge + photo cell 或 bridge。
檢查 safety input 是否符合設定。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: GA impulse function active.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

display_symbols.meaning_zh: 外部 photo cell 1 被遮斷；接在 X12。Photo cell 1 預設停用，需查看 parameter 31。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 photo cell 1 是否被遮擋。
檢查 X12 接線。
確認 parameter 31 設定。
recommended_checks_en: Check whether photo cell 1 is blocked or misaligned.
Inspect terminal X12 1-3.
Confirm parameter 31 enables photo cell 1 when it is installed.
Test whether the display changes when the beam is blocked and released.

display_symbols.meaning_zh: 外部 photo cell 2 被遮斷；接在 X3。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 photo cell 2 是否被遮擋。
檢查 X3 接線。
recommended_checks_en: Check whether photo cell 2 is blocked or misaligned.
Inspect terminal X3_6 20-22.
Confirm the factory bridge is present if no photo cell is installed.
Confirm parameter 31 matches the installed photo cell configuration.

display_symbols.meaning_en: Safety contact edge related operating display.
display_symbols.meaning_zh: Safety contact edge 相關運行顯示，可能代表 dead-man operation、safety contact edge interrupted 或 defective。
recommended_checks_zh: 確認是否為 dead-man operation。
檢查 safety contact edge 是否被觸發或損壞。
如顯示持續存在，檢查 safety contact edge 接線與參數設定。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm whether the display is caused by deadman operation.
Check whether the safety edge is activated, damaged, or not connected.
Verify parameter 21 matches the installed safety edge type.
Inspect X3_7 or X3_8 wiring according to the safety edge type.

error_messages.title_en: Safety contact edge not fitted correctly / incorrect parameter 21
error_messages.title_zh: Safety contact edge 未正確安裝 / parameter 21 選擇錯誤
error_messages.meaning_zh: Safety contact edge 安裝錯誤，或 parameter 21 選擇不正確。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 safety contact edge 接線。
檢查 parameter 21 設定是否符合 door hardware。
recommended_checks_en: Check safety edge wiring.
Confirm parameter 21 matches the installed safety edge type.
If OPTO or light curtain is selected, confirm X3_7 23-24 has no incorrect connection.
Run a full safety edge function test after correction.
error_messages.meaning_en: Safety contact edge not fitted correctly / incorrect parameter 21

error_messages.title_en: Error code: Door runs without command / SER
error_messages.meaning_zh: 嚴重故障：門在沒有命令時運行，可能需要維護或 circuit board 檢查。
recommended_checks_zh: 這是 serious fault，先確保現場安全。
手動將門移離 moving end positions，或在無電狀態下將門移至中間位置。
將 DIL switch no.1 從 normal mode 切換到 programming mode 以清除 SER。
若通電後 1 秒內門再次無指令運行，circuit board 可能 defective。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Error code: Door runs without command / SER.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.
error_messages.meaning_en: Error code: Door runs without command / SER

error_messages.meaning_zh: DW 門第一次 cycle 時會出現；第一次 cycle 和成功 self-test 後應消失。
recommended_checks_zh: 若未消失，重新設定 door end position。
若門沒有 DW，檢查 parameter 21。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Error code self-test DW.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

error_messages.meaning_zh: 若 power limit 功能啟動，門會被 power limit 停止；或返回 run mode 時 automatic power limit 未設定。
recommended_checks_zh: 設定 power control。
調整 parameter 44 sensitivity。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Error code: Power limit.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

error_messages.meaning_zh: 門在 run time setting 期間停止。
recommended_checks_zh: 查看 parameter 51。
檢查門是否機械卡阻或運行時間設定不合理。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Error code: Run time.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

error_messages.meaning_zh: Operating hours counter 減至 0，需要 reset 才能重新倒數。
recommended_checks_zh: 完成必要保養後 reset counter。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Error code: Maintenance.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

error_messages.meaning_zh: Photo-cell circuit 錯誤；最後停止後 test cycle failed。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 photo-cell circuit。
按 stop 開始新的 test。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Error code: Photo cell.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

error_messages.meaning_zh: Safety contact edge circuit 錯誤；最後停止後 test cycle failed。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 safety contact edge circuit。
按 stop 開始新的 test。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Error code: Safety contact edge.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

recommended_checks_zh: 檢查門的機械狀態是否良好。
Reset power limit。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Error code: Speed monitoring.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

error_messages.title_en: E:09 - No change in encoder position during operation
error_messages.title_zh: E:09 - 運行時 encoder position 沒有變化
error_messages.meaning_zh: 門已啟動，但 position 沒有變化；延遲後門停止並短暫顯示 E:09。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查門是否被卡住。
檢查 drive 是否 disconnected。
檢查 cable connection error。
Reset E09：需要以 dead-man operation impulse 方式重新找到兩個 end positions。
若無法找到兩個 end positions，重新設定 end positions。
必要時調整 parameter 81 delay time。
recommended_checks_en: Check whether the door is blocked, disconnected, or mechanically jammed.
Inspect encoder cabling at X13 and the door-leaf junction box.
Check 12V encoder supply at X13.
Move the door to both end positions in deadman mode or reprogram end positions to reset the error.
If the error repeats, inspect the encoder and motor cable.
error_messages.meaning_en: E:09 - No change in encoder position during operation

error_messages.title_en: Second safety contact edge or wicket (X20 3-4)
error_messages.title_zh: 第二 safety contact edge 或 wicket（X20 3-4）
error_messages.meaning_zh: Safety contact edge circuit 錯誤；最後停止後 test cycle failed。
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 wicket 或第二 safety contact edge circuit。
按 stop 開始新的 test。
recommended_checks_en: Press STOP to start a new test after the previous stop-circuit self-test failed.
Check stop circuit X20 3-4.
Inspect wicket/pass-door and safety contact edge wiring.
Use the stop-circuit meter tests to locate the interruption.
error_messages.meaning_en: Second safety contact edge or wicket (X20 3-4)

error_messages.title_en: EEPROM error - possible end position change after power limit set
error_messages.title_zh: EEPROM 錯誤 - power limit 設定後 end position 可能改變
error_messages.meaning_zh: 可能是 power limit 設定後 end positions 改變。
recommended_checks_zh: 嘗試在 parameter 41 關閉 power control（41:00），然後重新啟動。
recommended_checks_en: Check whether end positions were changed after force limitation monitoring was programmed.
Switch off force limitation monitoring in parameter 41 if required by the manual.
Restart the control box by disconnecting it from mains power.
Reprogram end positions if needed.
error_messages.meaning_en: EEPROM error - possible end position change after power limit set

recommended_checks_zh: 恢復 factory settings。
若仍無法解決，可能需要更換 processor。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: EEPROM error during start up.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 24V / 12V circuit 是否短路。
檢查是否有過載。
使用萬用錶量測相關供電。
recommended_checks_en: Check 12V and 24V power circuits for short circuit or overload.
Disconnect external 24V loads and retest the supply.
Check X3_6 18-19 24V supply and X13 encoder 12V supply.
Reconnect external devices one by one to locate the overloaded branch.

recommended_checks_zh: 若非預期動作，先停止操作並檢查控制輸入與安全迴路。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Door runs up.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

recommended_checks_zh: 若非預期動作，先停止操作並檢查控制輸入與安全迴路。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: Door runs down.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

recommended_checks_zh: 此項 manual 標示為不適用；如控制箱仍顯示，請記錄顯示並升級檢查。
recommended_checks_en: Confirm the display or symptom matches: E07 - Not applicable.
Inspect the related wiring, terminal, parameter, and connected device.
Use the related meter test when voltage, resistance, or continuity must be confirmed.
After correction, run a functional test before returning the door to service.

d15_led_errors.title_en: No answer from encoder / no 24 VDC control voltage
d15_led_errors.title_zh: Encoder 無回應 / 無 24 VDC 控制電壓
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 encoder connections。
檢查 X3 18-19 terminal 的 24 VDC voltage。
recommended_checks_en: Check wiring in the door-leaf junction box.
Check X13 cabling according to the manual.
Check 12V supply at X13 1-2.
d15_led_errors.meaning_en: No answer from encoder / no 24 VDC control voltage

recommended_checks_zh: 設定 open/closed end positions。
recommended_checks_en: Use the D15 flash count to confirm: End positions not set.
Check the related wiring, parameter, or component listed in the manual.
Restart or reprogram only after the physical cause is corrected.

recommended_checks_zh: Maintenance required，serious fault。
手動將門移離 moving end positions，或斷電時手動移至中間位置。
將 DIL switch no.1 從 normal mode 切換到 programming mode 以清除 SER。
若通電後 1 秒內仍無指令運行，circuit board defective。
recommended_checks_en: Use the D15 flash count to confirm: Motor runs unintentionally.
Check the related wiring, parameter, or component listed in the manual.
Restart or reprogram only after the physical cause is corrected.

recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 parameter 11 是否選擇正確（left/right turning）。
檢查是否兩個 end positions 相同。
檢查 encoder error。
recommended_checks_en: Use the D15 flash count to confirm: Calculation error.
Check the related wiring, parameter, or component listed in the manual.
Restart or reprogram only after the physical cause is corrected.

recommended_checks_zh: 此閃爍次數未使用。
recommended_checks_en: Use the D15 flash count to confirm: Not in use.
Check the related wiring, parameter, or component listed in the manual.
Restart or reprogram only after the physical cause is corrected.

recommended_checks_zh: 此閃爍次數未使用。
recommended_checks_en: Use the D15 flash count to confirm: Not in use.
Check the related wiring, parameter, or component listed in the manual.
Restart or reprogram only after the physical cause is corrected.

d15_led_errors.title_en: Encoder - incorrect selection of left/right turning
recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 parameter 11 是否選擇正確（left/right turning）。
或重新設定 end positions。
recommended_checks_en: Use the D15 flash count to confirm: Encoder - incorrect selection of left/right turning.
Check the related wiring, parameter, or component listed in the manual.
Restart or reprogram only after the physical cause is corrected.
d15_led_errors.meaning_en: Encoder - incorrect selection of left/right turning

recommended_checks_zh: 檢查 connection 和 supply voltage。
必要時更換 encoder。
recommended_checks_en: Check X13 cabling according to the manual.
Check 12V supply at X13 1-2.
Replace the encoder if the problem remains.

d15_led_errors.title_en: EEPROM fault on IC4 because of switching on electricity
recommended_checks_zh: Reset control to factory settings。
recommended_checks_en: Use the D15 flash count to confirm: EEPROM fault on IC4 because of switching on electricity.
Check the related wiring, parameter, or component listed in the manual.
Restart or reprogram only after the physical cause is corrected.
d15_led_errors.meaning_en: EEPROM fault on IC4 because of switching on electricity

steps_zh: 安裝/接線階段注意：不要先插入 CEE plug。
確認 DW / Opto / Light curtain / SCD / Passdoor 對應接線：X3.7、X3.8、X20。
確認 spiral cable、shaft drive encoder、ground wire、feed 和 cable 接入對應端子。
確認 230V / 400V 接線位置正確。
完成所有 plug-in plugs 後才進入供電或 programming。
steps_en: Follow the manual procedure for Basic installation.
Confirm the door area is safe before operation.
Check the display after each step and stop if an unexpected movement occurs.

procedures.title_zh: 基本設定 / 設定開關門終點
steps_zh: 插入 CEE plug 以 programming control box。
將 switch 1 移到 ON，進入 programming mode。
設定 open door position：按 manual 指定按鍵直到顯示對應 open position display。
如果按 UP 時門向下移動，使用一字螺絲刀反轉 CEE plug phases，然後重複設定步驟。
設定 closed door position。
將 switch 1 移回 OFF，退出 programming mode。
測試門的開門與關門操作。
steps_en: Follow the manual procedure for Basic programming.
Confirm the door area is safe before operation.
Check the display after each step and stop if an unexpected movement occurs.

steps_zh: 插入 CEE plug。
將 DIL switch 4 移到 ON / right。
同時按住 OP 與 STOP（arrow up 和 circle below），直到 display 顯示 FAC。
將 DIL switch 4 移回 OFF / left。
Factory settings 已恢復。
steps_en: Follow the manual procedure for Restore factory settings.
Confirm the door area is safe before operation.
Check the display after each step and stop if an unexpected movement occurs.

steps_zh: 插入 CEE plug 以連接 remote control。
按住 plug-in circuit board 上的 button；按住時會有聲音。
同時按 remote control button。
測試 remote control 操作；若無效，重複連接程序。
steps_en: Follow the manual procedure for Programming remote control.
Confirm the door area is safe before operation.
Check the display after each step and stop if an unexpected movement occurs.

key_points_zh: 適用 Pro-Line 28/50/70 CND1 control box installation。
包含 CND1 control box、spiral cable bracket、mounting parts 位置。
按照 quick start guide 的圖示固定 control box 和 bracket。
按 quick start guide step 1-8 打開控制盒與連接 cables。
Circuit boards 依 module：Opto module 10+11、DW module 12+13、Duo Opto module 20+21。
A=Spiral cable，B=Connecting cable，C=OPTO/OSE1/OSE2，D=SCD L/R / PD Switch。

home_buttons.description_zh: 技術人員看到什麼符號，就點選相似圖案。
選擇錯誤燈閃爍 1–9 次。
查看 basic programming、factory reset、remote control 等。
